source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check Jumper function
1. Switch jumper to another pin.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch jumper to another pin , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Jumper need functionaly.
3. Switch jumper to default pin , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Function Check: jumper function-check audit requires physically exercising jumpers and observing behaviour; human-only.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator exercises jumper functions and records effects; agent cannot move jumpers.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correct physical boundary but omits the unknown jumper identity, alternate/default pins, functional expectation and recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 adds exact mapping, power/ESD controls, alternate-state boot evidence and mandatory restoration.

original_test_intent: Verify an identified motherboard jumper produces its specified alternate-pin function, the SUT powers on to the expected function page/behavior, and normal clean operation returns after the jumper is restored to default.
original_method: Under a board-specific de-energization procedure, a qualified operator records the default position, moves the identified jumper to approved alternate pins, powers on and observes the specified behavior, powers off, restores default, reboots and checks for hang or new errors.
manual_activity: The operator must physically move and restore the shunt and directly observe its position and firmware/console behavior. Remote status cannot prove the jumper path.
required_inputs: Board revision, jumper reference and exact alternate/default pins
Boot/reconnect timeout, configuration backup and OOB/console recovery
Final state, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never move or bridge a jumper while powered and never test an unidentified reference.
Stop on wrong pins, no boot, hang, unexpected firmware behavior, error log or management loss.
Restore and visually verify the default position before final boot.
Preserve the first alternate/default result and do not automatically cycle or retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only board/firmware identity, boot, BMC/SEL and host logs around operator actions.
Correlate position photos with console/function-page and final no-error evidence.
Do not move hardware, infer physical position or set PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve jumper map, expected function and recovery.
Perform and document alternate/default physical moves and observations.
Verify final restored state and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can replace the physical action; the conclusion is correct but incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source physical sequence and use console/BMC/host telemetry only for supporting boot and error evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate move, power-on function check, default restoration, no-hang/no-error rule and 5/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL FUNCTION TEST WITH STATE TRANSITION RECORD
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a board-specific alternate/default transition checklist, timestamped pin-position photos, synchronized console capture and post-restore log/health comparison.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard revision and identified jumper function.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS/BMC/CPLD and specification revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner board jumper-function map and recovery SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous identity, observation and restoration evidence without changing the physical test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; both alternate-function and restored-default behavior remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mapping, function semantics, power procedure and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware screens and behavior are jumper-specific and cannot be generalized across references.

project_override_considerations: Projects must identify each tested jumper and expected function. Testing one reference cannot be reported as coverage of all jumpers, and alternate settings may not be left installed.
expected_evidence: Board/jumper/pin map, function expectation, power/ESD/recovery and authorization
Default and alternate position photos plus power/boot timestamps
Expected function page/behavior and console/BMC/SEL evidence
Restored default photo, clean boot/no-new-error comparison and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The phrase `negative to jumper function page check` is poorly worded but the criteria and context support observing the jumper-specific function after power-on; exact behavior is a required owner input, not a contradictory statement.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing jumper map and behavior are project readiness inputs. Once supplied, the operator can execute the coherent alternate/default sequence.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO and add identity, expected behavior and restoration evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and its alternate-state boot safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical execution and supporting automated logs from final engineer judgment.

review_improvement: Makes the actual jumper, alternate function and mandatory default restoration auditable instead of accepting a generic exercise note.
independent_technical_reasoning: The function is activated by changing a physical board connection and verified through physical position plus firmware behavior. Automation can observe boot evidence but cannot perform or prove the shunt movement, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
